tasks.instruction: Native google.image_generate requests cannot be priced using text-token cards, zero-price text cards, or OpenAI image cards. For this explicit request format, report opaque_input_bound at admission, no token-based reservation estimate and no actual token invoice, even with usage counters or billable:false. Preserve explicit policy-fixed pricing, ordinary Google text pricing, and qualified OpenAI image pricing. Only edit worker/pricing.ts; do not change tests, request formats, other files or provider manifests.

Dispatch native voyage.embeddings response accounting to the existing Voyage usage parser. A complete successful native embedding response reporting only total_tokens must yield equal input and total tokens and zero output tokens, without changing response bytes. Preserve generic usage behavior, rejection handling, malformed/absent usage handling, bounded parsing, cancellation and stream completion semantics. Do not infer an embedding split for generic responses or rejected requests. Only edit worker/proxy-response.ts; do not change tests or other files.

Qualify explicitly configured literal upstream paths for native and manifest openai.responses POST endpoints. Keep the public endpoint path /v1/responses and forward to the configured same-origin upstream path. Require matching response format and POST-only methods; reject queries, malformed/nonliteral paths, alternate public paths, websocket or lifecycle behavior, dynamic parameters and unqualified base URLs. Preserve existing chat/models path rules and caller-override rejection. Only edit worker/endpoint-path.ts; do not change tests, manifests, auth or other files.
